r173/ordinary-prime-coupled-diagonal-inc.question: Can the actual weighted full diagonal reach O(p^3/2) by keeping both nonzero physical input levels and the actual output weight?
r173/ordinary-prime-coupled-diagonal-inc.scope: Keep genuine g(Y),g(D),g(A),g(C), w(s), and b-square with s=b+r/E. In inverted coordinates 1/A is affine in X=1/s and 1/C is affine in s; seek coupled incidence or a weighted phase bound. Distinguish same-pole and distinct-pole errors if helpful.
r173/ordinary-prime-coupled-diagonal-inc.remaining: Obtain O(p^3/2) on the full weighted physical diagonal, or the target signed regular covariance including its zero-match piece. A genuine centered fixed-gap inverse estimate remains separate.

r173/ordinary-prime-full-weight-affine-e.question: Does actual masked weighted affine energy reach O(p^2), or is there an action gain using the actual input phases?

r173/cold-prime-moving-residual-coordina.question: Can a genuine moving cold starter with decaying residual satisfy the existing coordinate confinement bridge on the original square?
r173/cold-prime-moving-residual-coordina.scope: Keep the physical t0=n, original square, both lifts and the actual predictors. Try an explicit neighboring-orbit correction or moving starter with normalized residual r_n and signed shifted entries; do not use an inverse-defined tautology. State separately what is proved in counting versus translated and coordinate norms.
